svg.title: Print Farm Controller icon style catalogue — current and proposed line icons
svg.desc: Forty-two 24 by 24 outline icons. Twenty-one are representative existing concepts, and twenty-one are proposed for future controller features. Blue is current, teal is proposed.
svg.text: Print Farm Controller · 24 × 24 outline geometry · rounded joins · no gradients
Visual reference only: the live application remains the source of truth for deployed icons, statuses and interactions.
